review_scope: Evaluate whether MachineSignal should proceed from MCP/tool-registry private draft v2 toward public registry submission or hosted MCP.

agent_votes.summary: GO for current local stdio adapter and private registry-ready draft. NO-GO for hosted public MCP now. Hosted MCP needs scoped auth, revocation, read/write/admin separation, rate limits, audit, production key policy, data policy, conformance tests and cost guardrails.

GO only for private review, owner review, local stdio adapter and read-only manifest discovery. NO-GO for registry submission or hosted MCP. Main blockers: privacy/GDPR boundary, MCP security, fiscal/billing requirements, production keys and real data.

GO for GitHub/public docs and private draft/sandbox discoverability. NO-GO for irreversible external publication, public marketplaces, hosted MCP, billing live, production keys or outreach. Main risks: exposure, clonazione, rumore and false maturity signal.

agent_votes.agent: API Product Manager + Scoring Optimizer Desk
agent_votes.summary: Based on the v2 probe and product selector, the product routing is clear enough for private MCP review: no-list -> Target Discovery, existing list -> Score Pack, names without domains -> Domain Enrichment, high score -> Deep Analysis, confirmed deep gate -> Action Pack. Before go-live, API schema, quotas, write scopes, usage metrics and conversion/safety telemetry must be hardened.

go_now: keep MCP/tool-registry v2 as private registry-ready draft
continue local stdio adapter as the official MCP path
keep GitHub machine docs and passive public machine discovery
prepare owner-supervised hosted MCP architecture checklist
consensus.final_decision: GO for private MCP v2 review and local adapter. NO-GO for hosted MCP, registry submission or live monetization now.

risk_register.mitigation: Design scoped authorization, revocation, audit, rate limits, cost guardrails and read/write/admin separation before any hosted endpoint.
Keep synthetic/public documentation only. Build data map, legal basis, retention, DSAR flow and DPA/processor terms before real data.
Keep prices simulated and billing disabled. Before live billing, complete IVA/invoicing/reconciliation/legal terms review.
Accept passive discoverability, avoid public registry/marketplace launch now, keep production implementation details and keys private.
Continue stating sandbox-only, no hosted MCP, no live billing, no outreach and no production keys.
Before go-live, add formal quotas, usage telemetry, schema compatibility tests, error taxonomy and write-scope gating.

minimum_hosted_mcp_prerequisites: separate read-only, write-enabled and admin scopes
production key distribution and rotation policy
MCP conformance smoke tests against current spec
fiscal gate for live billing and invoices

next_action.recommended: Create a hosted MCP architecture checklist and go-live gate, but do not build or publish a hosted endpoint yet.
next_action.why: The private MCP draft is strong enough for review, but hosted/public MCP would introduce security, compliance, fiscal and operational obligations that are not yet closed.
